name: accessibility
title_zh: 按 WCAG 2.2 给网页做无障碍体检并给修复清单
tagline_zh: 用户说「做个无障碍」时，别只加 alt。它按 2.2 逐条查键盘、读屏、对比度，给出能直接改的修复项。
tagline_en: When asked to "make it accessible," don't just add alt text. It audits keyboard, screen reader, contrast against.
desc_en: Audit and improve web accessibility following WCAG 2.2 guidelines. Use when asked to "improve accessibility", "a11y audit", "WCAG compliance", "screen reader support", "keyboard navigation", or "make accessible".
why_zh: 不是给「建议」，而是给「断言」：每条失败都对应 WCAG 2.2 的具体条款和修复动作。比人工走查快。
why_en: It doesn't suggest—it asserts. Each failure maps to a specific WCAG 2.2 clause and a concrete fix. Faster than manual review.
limit_zh: 只审静态 HTML/CSS 可判定的项；动态交互、焦点陷阱、真实读屏体验需人工验证。产物是问题清单，不含自动修复补丁。
limit_en: Static HTML/CSS only; dynamic focus traps and real screen-reader UX need manual checks. Outputs findings, not patches. For SPAs, provide rendered.
